title: $12.4M LithoTrack MES Deployment for 5nm EUV Fab Yield Optimization and MTBF Tracking
executive_summary: NovaSemi Fab 8 proposes a 5-year $12.4M deployment of LithoTrack MES to optimize Class 1 cleanroom yield and track EUV equipment MTBF across 24 scanners. The commercial proposal promises aggressive uptime, speed, and service guarantees that diverge materially from the engineering constraints in the technical specification.

proposal_document.title: Commercial Proposal v1.0
proposal_document.text:
Our LithoTrack MES solution guarantees 99.99% system uptime for Class 1 cleanroom operations and delivers real-time overlay metrology feedback within 50 milliseconds to optimize yield to 98.5% across all EUV scanners. We include predictive MTBF tracking for ASML NXE:3400C tools with automated downtime prevention and full SECS/GEM integration at no additional cost.

Deployment will be completed in 45 days with zero disruption to ongoing wafer production, including migration of 2.5 million historical lot records and training for 150 operators. We also provide lifetime unlimited data retention with sub-second query response for any historical yield analysis and 24/7 on-site cleanroom support with 1-hour response time for the duration of the 5-year contract.

technical_specification.title: Technical Architecture Spec v4.2
technical_specification.text:
The LithoTrack MES platform is architected for 99.5% system availability excluding scheduled maintenance windows every Sunday 02:00-06:00 CST for database compaction and tool recalibration sync. Overlay metrology feedback loop operates at 500 milliseconds best-case latency under nominal fab network load (<60% utilization), with SECS/GEM HSMS integration certified for ASML NXE:3400C and NXT:1980Di scanners per SEMI E30/E37 standards.

Standard deployment timeline is 90-120 days requiring two planned 8-hour fab shutdowns for lot history migration, validated for up to 800,000 lot records with 12-month hot storage (sub-second query) and 36-month cold archival (4-12 hour retrieval). On-site cleanroom support is available Monday-Friday 08:00-18:00 CST with 4-hour response SLA, with after-hours and weekend coverage available as a premium add-on subject to separate SOW.

commitments.claim: 99.99% system uptime for Class 1 cleanroom operations
commitments.proposal_quote: guarantees 99.99% system uptime for Class 1 cleanroom operations
commitments.spec_quote: architected for 99.5% system availability excluding scheduled maintenance windows every Sunday 02:00-06:00 CST for database compaction and tool recalibration sync
commitments.explanation: Proposal guarantees 99.99% uptime with no exclusions, while spec limits availability to 99.5% and explicitly requires 4-hour weekly maintenance downtime, making the sales uptime mathematically impossible under the engineered architecture.

commitments.claim: Lifetime unlimited data retention with sub-second query for any historical analysis
commitments.proposal_quote: lifetime unlimited data retention with sub-second query response for any historical yield analysis
commitments.explanation: Spec defines strict storage limits of 12-month hot storage and 36-month cold archival with 4-12 hour retrieval and max 800,000 lot records, and provides no support for lifetime unlimited retention or sub-second queries on all history.

commitments.claim: 24/7 on-site cleanroom support with 1-hour response for 5-year contract
commitments.proposal_quote: 24/7 on-site cleanroom support with 1-hour response time for the duration of the 5-year contract
commitments.spec_quote: On-site cleanroom support is available Monday-Friday 08:00-18:00 CST with 4-hour response SLA, with after-hours and weekend coverage available as a premium add-on subject to separate SOW
commitments.explanation: Spec establishes baseline as business-hours with 4-hour SLA and references after-hours coverage only as a premium add-on under separate SOW, leaving it vague whether the proposal's 24/7 1-hour promise includes that paid add-on or assumes base coverage.

commitments.claim: Full SECS/GEM integration for ASML tools
commitments.proposal_quote: full SECS/GEM integration at no additional cost
commitments.spec_quote: SECS/GEM HSMS integration certified for ASML NXE:3400C and NXT:1980Di scanners per SEMI E30/E37 standards
commitments.explanation: Spec explicitly confirms certified SECS/GEM HSMS integration for the ASML NXE:3400C platform per SEMI standards, directly corroborating the proposal's integration commitment.
